schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The wire shape of codemother's `inspect` verb. wire_encode turns a judge's arguments or return value into a form the bus can carry, and wire_decode rebuilds it. A Path crosses as its string. A Workflow crosses as its workflow string and is parsed with parse_workflow on arrival. A Ticket crosses as its id. A frozenset and a tuple cross as lists. Anything else that is not JSON is refused by its type name.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: build_inspector's judges take Paths, Workflows, tickets and frozensets, and the bus carries JSON. Code outside codemother (transitions.py, hollow, ten outside proofs) is to ask those judges over the bus once build_inspector moves inside her (ticket 4c4addb09adb). The caller encodes the arguments and codemother decodes them, so one module holds both directions or the two sides drift. RULE 1 lets code outside a device reach into it only through a tool it publishes, so codemother publishes this one.
entry: Born 2026-11-13 under ticket 266d39d56d06: the two functions beside codemother's inspect verb, published so the callers 17d570c10390 and 149b9a1ab9c4 can reach them.
invoke: from cairn.devices.codemother.tools.inspect_wire.inspect_wire import wire_encode, wire_decode. Prove: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_answers_inspect_over_the_bus.py
state_and_history: A TOOL HOLDS NO STATE OF ITS OWN (Law 6). Its voyages ride history.json and state.json beside this charter, born at this address's first crossing.
proof: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_answers_inspect_over_the_bus.py. Tooth 3 sends a Workflow, a Path, a Ticket, a frozenset and a Workflow with no objects through this module over a scratch bus, and a spy judge on codemother's side receives each rebuilt equal to the caller's. Tooth 1 decodes every allow-listed judge's reply and compares it to the direct call.
gates: Import gate: encapsulation_holds in build_inspector admits a reach into codemother through this tool because this charter says published_by_device. Seal: the tester seals the proof into codemother's validations/.
falsifier: Red if a Workflow, a Path or a Ticket does not rebuild equal to what was sent, if a value with no wire form is coerced instead of refused, or if this charter stops declaring published_by_device.
how_it_learns: It does not; it is a codec, and a new argument type a judge takes is a new kind added here by a ticket.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation — a device's public interface is the bus plus any client tool it publishes)
Law 7 (a value with no wire form is refused by name, never coerced)
Law 1 (one module holds both directions, so the caller and the answerer cannot disagree)
owner: None of its own — a tool has users (Law 6): code outside codemother that asks `inspect`, and codemother's own verb. Its code is held by the codemother device, which publishes it; CC gates writes to that code and its proofs.
